# Compliance

<!-- Generated by ./scripts/compliance.sh from qualification/compliance/bend.yaml: edit that file and regenerate this one. -->

For every row of the compliance matrix of the OpenTelemetry specification
[v1.61.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/blob/v1.61.0/spec-compliance-matrix.md), this file says whether bend-telemetry
implements it, implements part of it, has it pending with the ticket that
implements it, or does not apply and why. The matrix is a list of features,
not a conformance suite; the [qualification harness](qualification/README.md)
checks what reaches a collector and a backend. This is a community project;
it is not part of, or endorsed by, the OpenTelemetry project.

The statuses live in
[qualification/compliance/bend.yaml](qualification/compliance/bend.yaml), in
the schema of the specification's own matrix files, and
`./scripts/compliance.sh` generates this file from them;
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#compliance) says when they change.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| implemented | The row holds. |
| partial | Part of the row holds: the note says which, and the ticket implements the rest. |
| pending | The row does not hold yet: the ticket implements it. |
| not applicable | The row does not apply to this project: the note says why. |

The Optional column is the specification's: `X` marks an optional row, `*` a
row of a group of which at least one is required, and a blank a required
row.

## Context Propagation

| Feature | Optional | Status | Ticket | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Create Context Key |  | not applicable |  | The context is a closed record with a field for each concern of the API, which that concern reads and sets with its own operations, such as `Api.Context.span_context` ([#5](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/5)); there are no keys ([#2](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/2)). |
| Get value from Context |  | not applicable |  | The context is a closed record with a field for each concern of the API, which that concern reads and sets with its own operations, such as `Api.Context.span_context` ([#5](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/5)); there are no keys ([#2](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/2)). |
| Set value for Context |  | not applicable |  | The context is a closed record with a field for each concern of the API, which that concern reads and sets with its own operations, such as `Api.Context.span_context` ([#5](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/5)); there are no keys ([#2](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/2)). |
| Attach Context |  | not applicable |  | There is no implicit context; every operation that needs a parent takes a context passed explicitly ([#2](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/2)), as Go records it. |
| Detach Context |  | not applicable |  | There is no implicit context; every operation that needs a parent takes a context passed explicitly ([#2](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/2)), as Go records it. |
| Get current Context |  | not applicable |  | There is no implicit context; every operation that needs a parent takes a context passed explicitly ([#2](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/2)), as Go records it. |
| Composite Propagator |  | pending | [#28](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/28) |  |
| Global Propagator | X | not applicable |  | Bend has no global state; instrumentation takes the propagator from the tracer provider it receives, the dependency injection that the specification allows ([#26](https://github.com/LucasGois1/bend-telemetry/issues/26)). |
